source: Akoumianaki E, Lyazidi A, Rey N, et al. Mechanical ventilation-induced reverse-triggered breaths: a frequently unrecognized form of neuromechanical coupling. Chest 2013; 143(4):927-938.
claim: In deeply sedated patients receiving mandatory mechanical breaths, ventilator-induced lung inflation can entrain diaphragmatic muscle contraction (reverse triggering) via a vagally mediated reflex. As established in Akoumianaki 2013, this is an empirical, rule-based neuromechanical coupling behavior (reverseTriggerProbability 0.40) causing delayed patient effort.
